mapper.select: SELECT ( CASE WHEN method_name LIKE 'save%' OR method_name LIKE 'add%' THEN '添加' WHEN method_name LIKE 'delete%' OR method_name LIKE 'remove' THEN '删除' WHEN method_name LIKE 'update%' THEN '编辑' WHEN method_name LIKE 'upload%' THEN '上传文件' ELSE method_name END ) AS type, count( 0 ) AS count FROM operate_log GROUP BY type ORDER BY count ASC, type ASC

SELECT ( CASE WHEN method_name LIKE 'save%' OR method_name LIKE 'add%' THEN '添加' WHEN method_name LIKE 'delete%' OR method_name LIKE 'remove' THEN '删除' WHEN method_name LIKE 'update%' THEN '编辑' WHEN method_name LIKE 'upload%' THEN '上传文件' ELSE method_name END ) AS type, avg( cost_time ) AS avgTime FROM operate_log GROUP BY method_name ORDER BY avgTime DESC, type ASC
